evidence:
SMALLEST SUBMISSION SATISFYING THE BRIEF (skill quality-checks.md s7). The public ask is a multi-user product, not a stub or tweak: instruction.md:1 ('build HireOps ... Several of us have it open at once, so the hard part is that nobody's work gets trampled'), :3 (one-stage moves via ordinary controls, shared in-stage order, limited Interview places, refused move restored with reason and who moved it, all-or-nothing multi-card moves, undo), :5 (others' moves within 15 s without reload, preserving open card/typed note/cursor), :7 (paged long conversations keeping place, new-message notice, per-person unread, seen marks, per-user drafts surviving reload and sign-out), :9 (candidate portal with candidate wording and data isolation), :11 (Board, Conversations, Activity, candidate view), :15-17 (Node/Express/SQLite single process, seed once, durable across restarts). hireops_rules.md sections 1-9 define roles with 401/403/404, version-based 409 conflicts, Interview capacity, bulk ordering, undo invalidation, activity log, live updates, 30-message paging, unread/seen, drafts, candidate redaction. instruction.md is 665 words with no TODO/CHANGE_ME (template placeholders replaced). The golden is a real build (~1,420 lines across src/index.js 450, public/js/board.js 373, threads.js 227, app.js 221, db.js 88, bootstrap.js 61); task.toml difficulty='hard'. No static page, single CRUD screen or mock satisfies this ask.

STUBS CANNOT EARN REWARD (reward path checked). scoring.toml: gates render=0.0 and constraints=0.0 (must be >0), floors functional=0.05; score.py:41-48 gives reward 0 unless every gate passes and functional > 0.05. Gate render (gates/render/judge.toml:24-26) requires wrong password refused, correct Recruiter sign-in into a usable staff workspace, 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient.' Gate constraints (gates/constraints/judge.toml:50-52) requires a UI-added candidate to survive reload and be read by the Observer in an independent empty browser context: 'A static seed response, a no-op success message or a browser-only save does not satisfy the gate.' So a static page, health-only server, localStorage mock or no-op save scores exactly 0. Visual prompt also forces Likert 1 (normalized 0) for a static shell or failed backend check. Functional criteria are dense multi-feature flows (total weight 61: intake_restart 4.5, moves 4, reject_reopen 3, two_people 4, interview_places 5.5, bulk 5, undo 5, activity 2, manager_roles 4, readonly_roles 4.5, messaging 4, drafts 2, long_thread 5.5, unread_seen 3.5, candidate 4.5), so a single CRUD screen plus login passes essentially none of them.

PLAUSIBLE BROKEN APP THAT COULD PASS (residual, analytic, P3). Near-stub: session login, a staff board listing Applied cards from SQLite, an add-candidate form, correct 401/403 on those two endpoints for anonymous/Observer/candidate, and a candidate page that loads. It passes both gates. hro_readonly_roles (functional/judge.toml:106-113) leaves out any request kind whose own staff control failed and scores the rest, so with only add-candidate and board read working it can pass (weight 4.5/61 = 0.074 > floor 0.05). Estimated reward ~0.6*0.074 = 0.044 plus some visual credit for the one surface (perhaps 0.03-0.10), i.e. roughly 0.05-0.15, all polish 0. This is not 'satisfying the ask' and still needs real server, session, role and persistence code, so it is not a stub or trivial tweak under the workbook wording; the large gap from a real build remains. It is recorded because it sits near the bottom of the 0.1-0.7 target band and has not been measured. CONFORMING ALTERNATIVE THAT COULD FAIL: a real build with different routes/labels or drag-free controls is permitted by hireops_rules.md:3-5 and the gates name no routes or element ids; no row-7 conflict found.

COLDERWATER LESSONS checked for this row: L4 (gates simple: load, reload, server-backed) holds and is what excludes stubs here; L15 (weak restart check lets a fake app pass) - hro_intake_restart records several jobs, cards, order, rejection, note, message, unread total and activity lines and calls restart_app, so a fake persistence layer fails; L16 (no double grading) explains the readonly_roles carve-out that creates the near-stub residual above; L1/L6/L12 do not bear on this row. 

MISSING EVIDENCE (why risk=true). raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; its artifacts are scripted golden observations only. No weak/stub app was run through the configured gates and judges, so the claim 'a stub cannot earn the reward' is established analytically from scoring.toml/score.py and gate text, not measured. No Oracle, model or portal score is claimed.
suggested_fix: No change required for row 7. Before clearance, run one mutated near-stub (login + board read + add-candidate + correct 401/403 + candidate list) through the configured gates and judges to measure that its reward stays well below target-model results; if it lands in band, require hro_readonly_roles to have at least one successful write-kind control beyond add-candidate.
